case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
sup:DEMO-F1.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our family foundry values the decades of trust between Demo Gießerei GmbH and Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. We have reviewed your proposals and, in the spirit of our long-standing partnership, are willing to accept the 24-month contract and the April 2027 effective date. 

However, a 60-day payment term is difficult for our family-run business, so we ask to meet at 45 days instead. On this basis, we can offer a revised price of €51.90 per unit. 

For complete clarity, our main offer stands at a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €51.90 per unit. Another option is a price of €51.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. 

This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

It is always a pleasure to work together with partners who value quality casting and a trustworthy relationship as much as we do here at our foundry.

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

For generations, our family foundry has stood for craftsmanship, reliability, and deep roots in our region. We truly value the long-standing partnership between Demo Gießerei GmbH and Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. In response, we are prepared to make a further concession to €51.10 per unit for the 60-day payment term. 

To summarize our Angebot, we offer a price of €51.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this brings us close to a final agreement that reflects the value of our long-standing partnership. My team and I look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
